items.exampleEn: The workers dug a deep pit.
The fishing boats go out at high tide.
Coastal cities often have strong winds.
The soap made lots of bubbles.
Agriculture is still important in this region.
items.exampleZh: 農業在這個地區仍然很重要。

items.exampleEn: The bull ran toward the red flag.
The house stands at the top of a cliff.
items.exampleZh: 那棟房子位在懸崖頂上。

items.sentenceEn: This coastal road has beautiful views.
items.sentenceZh: 這條沿海道路的風景很美。

items.audioEn: Don't walk on the beach after five today; the tide comes in fast and covers the sand.
items.audioZh: 今天五點後不要在海灘上散步；潮水漲得很快，會淹沒沙灘。
items.questionZh: 為什麼五點後不要在海灘散步？
options: There will be a big storm.

items.sentenceEn: Low tide is the best time to find shells.
items.sentenceZh: 退潮時是找貝殼的最好時機。

items.sentenceEn: The farm has one bull and twenty cows.
items.sentenceZh: 這座農場有一頭公牛和二十頭母牛。

items.stemEn: Children love to blow ____ in the bath.
items.stemZh: 孩子們喜歡在洗澡時吹泡泡。

items.stemEn: Be careful near the edge of the ____; it's a long way down.
items.stemZh: 在懸崖邊要小心，下面很深。

items.passageEn: Our science class took a trip to a coastal town. First, a guide told us about agriculture near the sea: some plants can grow well right next to the sea. On the way, a huge bull stood behind a fence and watched us. We also saw a deep pit that people once used to keep food in. Then we walked along the top of a cliff. When the tide went out, we climbed down to the rocks and looked into small areas of water between them. Air bubbles came up from the sand because small animals were hiding there. Our teacher said each one is full of tiny organisms. Later, we took some water back to the school laboratory.
items.passageZh: 我們的自然課到一個沿海小鎮校外教學。首先，導覽員跟我們介紹海邊的農業：有些植物就算緊鄰海邊也能長得很好。路上，一頭巨大的公牛站在圍欄後面看著我們。我們還看到一個從前的人用來儲存食物的深坑。接著我們沿著懸崖頂端走。退潮時，我們爬下去到岩石區，看岩石間一小片一小片的水。沙子裡冒出氣泡，因為有小動物躲在裡面。老師說每一小片水裡都有很多微小的生物。後來，我們帶了一些水回學校的實驗室。

questions.questionZh: 退潮時學生們去了哪裡？
沙子裡為什麼會冒出氣泡？
options: 因為潮水帶來了大量空氣
因為有人在附近挖了深坑

rubricZh: agriculture 表示「農業」，是不可數名詞，例如 depend on agriculture 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 bubble 造一個句子，說說你玩泡泡或看到氣泡的經驗。
referenceEn: I loved blowing bubbles when I was a child.
I saw bubbles rising in my glass of water.
rubricZh: bubble 表示「泡泡、氣泡」，可數名詞，例如 blow bubbles 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）
